text: @opencode-ai/plugin pins an internal zod version; installing latest zod broke tool schema typecheck until zod was pinned to exactly the plugin's dependency version
opencode host can pass worktree="/" as a truthy sentinel when no worktree is determined; naive truthiness checks routed journal discovery to the filesystem root
plugin files nested under .opencode/plugins/<dir>/index.ts are NOT auto-discovered; only top-level .ts files are, so explicit plugin config entry is required for subdirectory layouts
this machine has /tmp/.git, which pollutes any test walking up from tmpdir to find a repository root

note: zod pinned to 4.1.8 in package.json, typecheck green
startDirectory prefers directory and rejects root sentinel; regression test plugin.test.ts
README.md "Install" section documents that only top-level .ts/.js files in .opencode/plugin(s)/ are auto-discovered and shows explicit config entry for nested layouts

text: tsconfig.json only includes src/, so scripts/ and test/ are never typechecked even though npm run typecheck is the repo's verification gate

opencode run drains non-TTY stdin until EOF before starting, so child_process.spawn with a default (never-ended) stdin pipe hangs forever with zero output; harnesses must pass stdio ['ignore','pipe','pipe'] or end() stdin
ripgrep (rg) is not installed in this environment, so bash search commands assuming it fail with exit 127; agents should rely on the Grep tool or plain grep instead.

opencode resolves the project from $PWD instead of getcwd(), so child_process.spawn with cwd=fixture still runs sessions against the caller's repo (contaminating it); harnesses must pin env.PWD to the target directory
ripgrep (rg) not installed in this environment; two tool calls were lost defaulting to rg before falling back to grep — check for rg availability or default to grep
GitHub code search requires login for anonymous users, blocking lookup of opencode's internal TUI plugin sources and forcing a slow git-trees API walk to find the Todo sidebar implementation
